// diagnostic

E3206

module path `{path}` uses the reserved segment `__bindgen__`.

What

module path `{path}` uses the reserved segment `__bindgen__`.

Why

Autogen lives in `c.{lib}.__bindgen__`; users declare overlays as `#Extern module c.{lib}` only.

Fix

Drop `__bindgen__` from your module path, or use `#Extern module c.{lib} { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3206: tests/ui/generated_cffi_e3206.stderr.

Error [E3206]: module path `c.demo.__bindgen__` uses the reserved segment `__bindgen__`
  --> tests/ui/generated_cffi_e3206.jet:2:16
    |
  2 | #Extern module c.demo.__bindgen__ {
    |                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: autogen lives in `c.<lib>.__bindgen__`; users declare overlays as `#Extern module c.<lib>` only
 Fix: drop `__bindgen__` from your module path, or use `#Extern module c.demo { … }`

Error [E0065]: this function uses the retired `=` body marker.
  --> tests/ui/generated_cffi_e3206.jet:3:15
    |
  3 |     fn ping() = "demo_ping"
    |               ^
 Why: A one-expression function body uses `->`; `::` binds a name, and `=` fills a slot inside a definition.
 Fix: replace `=` with `->`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0065

Error [E0003]: expected a call, binding, assignment, or `return`, found `}`
  --> tests/ui/generated_cffi_e3206.jet:4:1
    |
  4 | }
    | ^
 Why: inside a function body, write a call, binding, assignment, or `return`
 Fix: e.g. print("hello") or x :: 1
